narrative:
The GBP 800M retail estate transformation is the largest investment in the plan. In FY2026/27, 67% of programme milestones are forecast to be delivered on budget, with an average payback of 48 months, six months better than the original business cases.

Waitrose refurbishments lead: refurbished shops trade 6% ahead of control. The three new convenience shops are the most time-critical, with two of three planning consents secured. Technology modernisation sits at 61%, but the GBP 120M of legacy technology write-downs has already been taken and the Meter cut-over plan de-risks what remains.

Estate depreciation of GBP 27M flows straight into the management operating profit bridge.

signals.title: GBP 800M retail estate transformation
signals.excerpt: 28 Waitrose refurbishments and 3 new convenience shops, John Lewis shop refresh and supply chain automation over the plan period.

signals.title: Meter Programme — 5 legacy data platforms into Snowflake
signals.excerpt: Consolidating BigQuery, Teradata, SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL estates onto Snowflake. Oracle Finance (CDC), Kooper and DIDOS already landed but under-used by Finance.

signals.title: Lessons from DCNRT
signals.excerpt: A prior finance data project did not deliver. Waitrose-first phasing on data already in Snowflake de-risks the next step.
